title: In JetBrains Ktor before 3.6.1 hTTP request smuggling was possible in the CIO engine (CVE-2026-123318)
description: JetBrains Ktor versions prior to 3.6.1 contain a vulnerability in the CIO engine that allows HTTP request smuggling. This flaw could enable an attacker to interfere with the processing of HTTP requests, potentially leading to limited confidentiality and integrity impacts. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.8. No official patch links are provided, but the issue is fixed starting from version 3.6.1.
